use_cases.title: Place a bouquet order as a guest
use_cases.description: A visitor completes the end-to-end purchase flow by adding an in-stock bouquet to the basket, seeing the basket total reflect what was added, choosing a delivery date that excludes Sundays, checking out without creating an account, and receiving an on-screen order confirmation with an order number; the same flow must work on a phone because the site is intended to take orders from mostly mobile, Instagram-led customers without Sarah’s direct involvement.
use_cases.value: Captures revenue through self-serve online ordering without requiring staff or account creation.

cite.quote:
3. A visitor can complete checkout as a guest — we agreed no account is
   required, because Sarah's customers are mostly one-off buyers.

cites.quote:
3. A visitor can complete checkout as a guest — we agreed no account is
   required, because Sarah's customers are mostly one-off buyers.

2. A visitor can add a bouquet to the basket, and the basket total updates to
   reflect what they added.

4. Delivery date selection: the customer must not be able to choose a Sunday,
   since Sarah does not deliver on Sundays.

5. After a successful order the customer sees an order confirmation with an
   order number, and Sarah receives the order by email.
6. If a bouquet is out of stock it must not be addable to the basket.

7. The whole flow above must work on a phone. Sarah says most of her customers
   are on Instagram on their phones.

use_cases.title: Receive online orders by email
use_cases.description: Sarah receives each successfully placed order by email so the shop can process online purchases even when nobody is available to answer the phone or Instagram DMs, which is the operational mechanism this milestone uses to let the website take orders without her direct involvement at the moment of purchase.
use_cases.value: Prevents missed orders by notifying the florist of successful online purchases.

use_cases.title: Browse bouquet catalogue
use_cases.description: A visitor browses the bouquet catalogue and can see the price of each bouquet before deciding whether to add anything to the basket, and this storefront discovery experience must also work on a phone because most customers arrive from Instagram on mobile devices.
use_cases.value: Lets customers discover products and prices before starting an order.
